purpose: Repeat the same frozen 64-source exact named-plate 81x81 stamp pilot with two narrowly scoped repairs established by the C1A corrective audit: pre-pixel geometric edge eligibility and raw-positive intensity/moment convention matching the upstream Source Extractor input convention. Preserve the full 64-row denominator and all unrelated measurement formulas and thresholds.

frozen_sample.selection_rule_unchanged: For each frozen structural cluster 0..15: two closest to cluster-median anomaly score plus two highest anomaly score, src_id tie-break.

unchanged_from_C1A: diagnostic moment centroid is never fed back into any aperture
outer Laplacian MAD and 5-MAD outlier-fraction formulas

repair_1_geometric_eligibility.rule: For frozen floating full-plate center (x,y), define ix=round(x), iy=round(y), x0=ix-40, x1=ix+41, y0=iy-40, y1=iy+41. A source is GEOMETRICALLY_ELIGIBLE_81PX iff x0>=0, y0>=0, x1<=NAXIS1 and y1<=NAXIS2 for its exact named plate header.
repair_1_geometric_eligibility.ineligible_handling: Retain the row in the full 64-row sidecar with GEOMETRIC_EDGE_INELIGIBLE_81PX; do not read pixels, move the window, change plate, search for a source or impute morphology.
repair_1_geometric_eligibility.transport_denominator: All rows classified GEOMETRICALLY_ELIGIBLE_81PX before pixel access.
repair_1_geometric_eligibility.unexplained_failure_policy: Any eligible row that does not return an exact 81x81 hdu.section is a transport failure.

repair_2_raw_positive_intensity.background_sigma: 1.4826*MAD of raw pixels in frozen outer annulus 18<=r<=38
repair_2_raw_positive_intensity.reason: Upstream run_pass1 presents the raw reconstructed FITS directly to Source Extractor, and sex_pass1.sex uses DETECT_TYPE CCD / DETECT_THRESH 5.0. The new direct estimator must therefore use the same raw-positive input convention rather than borrowing the inversion used only by the experimental profile_diff preconditioner.

predeclared_gates.full_denominator_integrity: 64/64 frozen src_id rows retained exactly once in the output sidecar.
predeclared_gates.eligibility_determinism: Every row receives exactly one pre-pixel eligibility state derived only from frozen coordinates, 81px geometry and named-plate NAXIS1/NAXIS2.
predeclared_gates.eligible_transport: 100% of GEOMETRICALLY_ELIGIBLE_81PX rows return exact 81x81 stamps from their frozen named plate; zero unexplained eligible-source failures.
predeclared_gates.central_raw_signal: At least 95% of geometrically eligible rows have finite stamp_raw_peak_snr >= 5.0.
predeclared_gates.diagnostic_raw_centroid: At least 95% of geometrically eligible rows have finite raw-positive diagnostic centroid offset <=4.0 px and 100% are <=8.0 px.
predeclared_gates.raw_moment_feature_coverage: At least 95% of geometrically eligible rows have finite stamp_raw_moment_fwhm_proxy_px and stamp_raw_moment_ellipticity.
predeclared_gates.contour_feature_coverage: At least 90% of geometrically eligible rows have finite stamp_circularity and stamp_circle_deviation. shape_defect finite coverage is report-only.
predeclared_gates.outer_texture_coverage: 100% of geometrically eligible rows have finite raw background sigma, stamp_outer_laplacian_mad and stamp_outer_5mad_outlier_fraction.
predeclared_gates.no_retrofit: No gate threshold, radius, polarity, stamp size, contour formula, eligibility formula or denominator may change after C1A2 outcome.

report_only_crosschecks: sparse-stamp contour differences vs B3S contour metrics
raw-positive vs failed C1A inverted intensity summaries where both are available

forbidden_inputs: Blue Book or other human-report labels
